svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Why ROC-AUC Flatters a Rare-Event Model
The same classifier scored two ways on 1% positives
Same model, same 20,000 samples, 1% positives. Only one of these two numbers is honest about the task.
ROC's baseline is the diagonal regardless of prevalence. PR's baseline IS the prevalence.
